not_scored.reason: at its stated formula one table needs 12-29 GB per worker; the scheduler killed it, and capping its bucket sizes would be a different metric
three evaluations per table (real plus two nulls) exceeded the benchmark deadline on 97 pairs

conclusion: Four new hyperbolic metrics were implemented to their proposals' formulas and measured on the same 97 confirmed pairs. None tracks recall: the two partition-tightness metrics sit near zero, the tree-conditional path likelihood is significantly NEGATIVE (-0.49) because it rewards a trie with few branches (its correlation with the number of level-2 buckets is -0.78, and its three highest values are the 12-, 2- and 3-code collapsed tables), and the size-matched reach lift is +0.04. Q_H's +0.634 remains the only metric in the collection that tracks recall. The pattern across all of them is that a metric of the partition's own geometry -- tightness, margin, likelihood, size-matched reach -- does not predict the recall of the table, while the one metric that does is CONTRASTIVE against the behaviour reference with explicit positive and negative items.

behaviour_side_test.question: does the next-item behaviour have exploitable hierarchical structure?
behaviour_side_test.probe: the 57439 training queries, the Gromov depth gap between the query point and the positive's item minus the mean gap to the ten negatives
behaviour_side_test.reading: the behaviour relation IS hierarchical in the hyperbolic geometry: the positive shares a deeper common ancestor with the user's anchor in 83% of the queries, and the depth gap is five times the Euclidean one on the same objects. The hyperbolic reading of the Gromov product is therefore not a figure of speech: the flat control cannot reproduce the separation.

counter_examples.reading: a collapse scores zero and a random assignment scores zero, so neither can be rewarded

caveats: the metric was selected on the same 97 pairs it is measured on, so its +0.701 is optimistic; a fresh SID+recall sample is needed

the Euclidean and flat controls score +0.693 and +0.693 against the hyperbolic +0.701: the ranking of tables is a property of the construction, not of the curvature, even though the behaviour itself is hierarchical in the hyperbolic geometry (mean depth gap +0.089 against the Euclidean +0.018, same 83% share)
observational: the tables come from different families and settings
winner.levels_note: HBAA at every level and averaged gives +0.4644, BELOW the level-1 score +0.7012: the ancestor contrast at the deeper levels is real but weaker, so averaging them in loses information. The level-1 ancestor depth is the signal.

refinements_tried.reading: the refinements of the winner's own family are all weaker than the winner: the signal is the level-1 ancestor DEPTH contrast, not a ranking statistic

family.reading: every variant of the winner is weaker than the winner: the level-1 Gromov ancestor-DEPTH contrast against the negatives' prefix centroids, with the full history as the query point and the frozen temperature in the reduction, is the signal. Ranking statistics over the same cells, the deeper levels, a temperature-free reduction and the weighted multi-level combination all lose information.

significance_vs_the_incumbent.reading: HBAA is better than Q_H by +0.067 of Spearman on average, but the paired bootstrap interval of the difference touches zero (-0.003): the two are not separated by this sample. HBAA itself is stable: over 800 random half-samples its rho never fell below zero and averaged +0.697.

the_held_out_probe.note: the validation pairs the teacher never saw; still above Q_H's +0.634

input_sweep.reading: every input choice has been swept and none of them beats the incumbent by more than the interval width: the metric is the level-1 Gromov ancestor-depth contrast with the full history, read through any frozen teacher.

defects_found_and_fixed: the Delta was implemented as negative-minus-positive in the first HBAA run (-0.696): the behaviour-side check with the proposal's order exposed it

the radial term of the Gromov product was half the geodesic distance (arccosh(1/sqrt(1-r^2)) instead of 2*arccosh(...)); after the fix the champion's correlation is unchanged (+0.7012), the anchor control moves to +0.6866 and the temperature-free variant to +0.6988
the numpy Karcher mean had to be rewritten with the base-point maps to agree with the frozen torch routine (max difference 3.7e-11)
